bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/admin1/server-core
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 7fede271a9459b998935e1ae9995d7feba27d9c5
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-servercore-service-deploy.service
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' server-core-bounded-host)" = gace-server-core-bounded-host:hostsha-7fede271
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' server-core-bounded-host)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' server-core-bounded-host)" = healthy
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' server-core-bounded-host-pre-pr345)" = false
docker exec server-core-bounded-host python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s=Path("/app/scripts/servercore_bounded_host_receiver.py").read_text(); assert "replay_only" in s and "HOST_COMMAND_REPLAY_MISSING" in s'
printf 'RECEIVER_IMAGE_RUNTIME_PASS\n'
